shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git ls-files
cat package.json index.html src/*.tsx tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md
rg -n -C 6 'page-constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat .gitignore
npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40
npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@8.24.1 @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -A6 '"dependencies"' package.json
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock ExtendedFeaturesBlock BannerBlock 2>&1 | head -60
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock ExtendedFeaturesBlock BannerBlock 2>&1 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && wc -l build/docs/INDEX.md && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; ls build/docs build/docs/* | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && sed -n 120,192p INDEX.md; echo ----; cat blocks/Header.md blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md blocks/Banner.md; echo ---; head -40 blocks/Hero.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; ls node_modules | grep -E '^(sass|vite-plugin-dynamic-import)$'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n '/^## Theming/,$p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -110; grep -rn "color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Banner/Banner.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "vite-plugin-dynamic-import\|sass" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head

sed -n 505,545p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; cat vite.config.ts; grep -n "theme\|interface PageConstructorProviderProps" -A0 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts | head
npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | grep -iE "err|added" | head

grep -rn "Theme\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export declare enum Theme\|export type Theme " -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head

grep -rn "useThemeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -4; grep -n "RealTheme =" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.scss | head -20; grep -rln "~@" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles | head

sed -i "s#alias: \[{ find: /^~(@gravity-ui\\\\/.\*)\$/, replacement: '\$1' }\]#alias: [{ find: /^~(@[^/]+\\\\/.*)\$/, replacement: '\$1' }]#; s#webpack-style \`~@gravity-ui/...\` imports#webpack-style \`~@scope/pkg\` CSS imports#" vite.config.ts && grep -n "alias\|webpack" vite.config.ts && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s*$" | tail -12
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s*$|^\s+at " | tail -20
npm install url 2>&1 | grep -E "added|ERR"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s*$|^\s+at |DEPRECATION|sass-lang|^\s+[│╷╵]|^[0-9]+ │|node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/" | tail -20

sed -n 8,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js; grep -o "pc-banner-card[^{]*theme[^{]*{[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head

grep -o "\.pc-banner-card_theme[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head; grep -o "\.pc-header-block[^{]*{[^}]*color[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.css | head -5
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/; grep -rho "\.pc-banner-card_theme_[a-z]*[^{]*{[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/ | head -4
grep -o "theme[^{]*{[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head -6
grep -n "theme\|color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.css | head -15
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff package.json
